seats.text:
I've implemented `format` in `format.ts`, but I haven't run or tested it, so I don't know yet whether it matches the README on every case.

It follows the README's rules for all the listed conversions, flags, widths and precisions, including `%%`.

Float rounding is done with exact bigint arithmetic on the binary value, using round-half-even. That is how cases like `%.2f` of 2.675 giving `2.67` and `%.0f` of 2.5 giving `2` should come out right.

I didn't check the `g`/`G` boundary cases (where the exponent changes after rounding), the `#` flag with `g`, or subnormal values.
